# BE3

## About

Why should every app need to reinvent live collaborative editing, permissions, accounts, undo/redo, rich text editing, teams, ...etc?

BE3 aims to solve this.

## Development

See .github/workflows/ci.yml for detailed instructions

Basic setup:

install rustup, `rustup default stable`, install cargo-nextest

```
# run app
./scripts/run

# test app
./scripts/verify

# run for web
./scripts/run --target web

# run for android
./scripts/run --target android
```
